title: ATTP publishes its Annual Activity Report for the 2024–2025 season
body_html:
The document sets out in detail our efforts, projects and results in promoting and developing table tennis nationwide.

During the reporting season, ATTP organised and ran hundreds of events and competitions — from the ATTP Super Cup and Super League to the Masters tournaments, junior and senior championships, and numerous initiatives to popularise table tennis in local communities. Through these projects ATTP has strengthened the base of the sport, attracted new enthusiasts and given players the chance to prove their worth at the table.

The 2024–2025 season brought unprecedented success for ATTP-affiliated players and teams. International performances were celebrated, remarkable results were achieved at European-level competitions, and Moldovan table tennis showed that it can truly compete at the highest standards. At the same time, ATTP kept investing in developing the younger generations, to secure a solid base and a safe future for our sport.

For the whole sporting community, this report is more than a list of figures and events. It is proof of a collective effort, of a community united by passion and professionalism, and a confirmation of the role ATTP plays in modernising and developing table tennis in the Republic of Moldova.

“We firmly believe that the results we have achieved are the foundation on which we will build new successes. We will keep working so that table tennis becomes a leading sport, respected and loved by the whole of society,” ATTP President Rostislav Sobiețki stresses in his conclusions.
